The percentage of all MSM who achieved viral suppression within 6 months of diagnosis increased 6.8% per year
The percentage of all MSM who were linked to care within 1 month of diagnosis increased 2.9% per year
the rate of annual decrease among Black MSM (1.3%) was less than that among White MSM (4.8%)
CDC analyzed National HIV Surveillance System data from 2014 to 2018

methods_quotes.q: The estimated annual percentage change (EAPC) was calculated for each MSM group.
the EAPCs in case counts were calculated by using a Poisson distribution.
Multiple imputation was used to adjust for unknown or missing transmission category (15.6% of cases)
EAPC p-values <0.05 indicated statistically significant trends, whereas p-values ≥0.05 indicated no significant change.
